newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO buys Hungary's MHB for $89.23 mln.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO buys Hungary's MHB for $89.23 mln.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV said on Friday it had been selected by the Hungarian authorities to acquire a majority stake in Hungary's Magyar Hitel Bank (MHB) at a price of $89.23 million.

"The deal, which is expected to be finalised before the end of the year, covers the sale of an 89.23 percent stake in Magyar Hitel Bank," the Dutch bank said in a statement. It added it had also committed itself to substantially increase MHB's capital.
"The total transaction is one of the largest foreign investments in a commercial bank in Central and Eastern Europe to date," ABN AMRO said.

MHB is Hungary's fifth largest commercial bank with a network of 70 branches across the country. It is also a leading bank for domestic major companies and is active in capital markets, leasing and factoring.
